info.name: CapAuth
info.description:
CapAuth lets you sign in to Nextcloud using your sovereign PGP key. No passwords. No OAuth flows. Just cryptographic proof of identity.
## Features
- **Passwordless PRIMARY login** via PGP challenge-response (no password, no Authentik, no OAuth) — a real Nextcloud user backend, not just a 2FA second factor. - **"Sign in with CapAuth"** button on the login page. - **Bearer token authentication** for API requests. - **Auto-provisioning** of users from CapAuth identity claims. - **Group synchronisation**: CapAuth teams map to Nextcloud groups.
## How it works
The client signs a server-issued challenge nonce with their PGP private key. CapAuth verifies the signature against the registered public key and issues a Nextcloud session — the private key never leaves the user's device.
